patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I was hanging upside down on the monkey bars like a bat, and then I wasn't. My chin bonked the ground. Do I get the glue or the sewing?
clinical.presentationShort: 7yo M — fell from monkey bars; 2 cm clean linear chin laceration, no full-thickness/intraoral involvement, jaw & dentition normal, NV intact.
clinical.presentationLong: 7-year-old male, fell from the monkey bars onto his chin, a 2 cm clean linear laceration with no full-thickness or intraoral involvement, jaw and teeth intact.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → irrigate, tissue adhesive or sutures, confirm tetanus; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Clean simple lac — glue or a couple of sutures, check tetanus status. No imaging needed.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image.
